layout: Each record: command u8 (0 concat,1 invert,2 adapt,3 primaries), flag u8, followed by 18/18/11/17 little-endian u32 float words. No expected outputs are stored. All first preflight inputs, including four failing NaN-sign cases, are retained exactly.
origin: Data-only deterministic preflight corpus; actual original public functions provide every expected observation at test time.
defined_original_graphs: All 71,226 requests return cleanly and byte-identically with unchanged ordinary and nonrecovering ASan/UBSan original CMS archives.
